note: CLOSED, AND CARRYING AN UNAPPLIED PROMOTION TO "dedicated". Third closed venue in this shard, and the worst case: Tabelog https://tabelog.com/tokyo/A1311/A131101/13304848/ is 【閉店】; the operator's own Instagram profile reads 「-closed-】GlutenFree avanエキュート上野店 … 5/10を持ちまして閉店致しました」 (2026-05-10 on the evidence — a celiac blogger visited 2026-02-16 and another 2026-03-24); AND the cited website www.avan-sweets.com no longer resolves at all (NXDOMAIN), so every claim on this record points at a dead domain. Meanwhile the record holds gf_proposed_tier {to:"dedicated", confidence:"high", date:2026-08-19} awaiting human sign-off. That promotion must NOT be granted — not because the GF evidence is weak (it is genuinely strong: 「当店のメニューは調味料からすべて小麦粉不使用です」, はえぬき rice flour, 米油, in-store frying, FindMeGlutenFree "Dedicated Gluten-Free Dessert Shop" 4.5/76) but because the shop is shut. A "dedicated" badge on a closed business is exactly the failure mode this sweep exists to catch. Of 12 uncited claims, 8 are now evidenced (via Wayback + さんたつ + PR TIMES + a celiac blog), 3 are unsupported, 1 quotes a string (「完全小麦不使用」) that exists nowhere. vegan_status "limited" should be "no" — dairy is in every churro. Recommended action: flag closed; if the brand is re-listed later, note the Maebashi (Gunma) store was still on the last shop list.

PHANTOM VENUE. Across Yahoo Japan (Japanese and English, with the name exact-quoted), Tabelog's own rstsearch and Vegewel, there is no restaurant called 「ヴィーガンラーメン GREEN EARTH」 in 新宿西口 or anywhere else in Tokyo — no listing, no address, no phone, no website (the record's website field is already null). The nearest real match is Green Earth in OSAKA (北久宝寺町), a long-established vegan restaurant, which suggests a mis-located import rather than a fabricated name. All 5 claims are uncited, and 4 of them are hypotheticals about what a ramen shop would be like IF this one existed. The record's own enrich_confidence is "low" and safety.confidence is "none" — the data is honest about itself; the map is not. gf "ask" / vegan "ask" cannot be defended or attacked because there is no venue to rate. RECOMMENDED ACTION: delete or quarantine this record. A pin a celiac can walk to that turns out not to exist costs trust the same way a wrong safety label does. This is the one record in the shard I would pull before any other.
